threads.name: Guppypedia — Care and Water
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Care and Water**
Healthy guppies need a fully cycled aquarium, stable mineral-appropriate freshwater, gentle filtration and space for growing broods. Practical setup guidance is not a universal wild tolerance limit.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/care/
Sources: https://www.ifga.org/basiccare | https://www.merckvetmanual.com/exotic-and-laboratory-animals/aquarium-fish/management-of-aquarium-fish

threads.name: Guppypedia — Show Tail Standards
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Show Tail Standards**
The European IKGH 2023 standard recognizes 13 tail shapes; these are standard classes, not 13 independent bloodlines. Dumbo, ribbon and swallow are additional fin traits, not guaranteed genetic pedigrees.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/strains/
Sources: https://www.ikgh.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/IHS-Version-2023.pdf

threads.name: Guppypedia — Genetics and Lineage
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Genetics and Lineage**
Phenotype and trade names alone do not prove parentage, creator, or sex linkage. Treat official body-color categories, named breeder lines, and hybrids separately; do not invent pedigree arrows.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/genetics/
Sources: https://www.ikgh.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/IHS-Version-2023.pdf

threads.name: Guppypedia — Controlled Breeding
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Controlled Breeding**
Use separate line IDs and tanks, document both parents, generations and health, and separate young sexes before unwanted mating. Sperm storage makes purchased adult females unsuitable as assumed virgin founders.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/breeding/
Sources: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.exppara.2016.04.018

threads.name: Guppypedia — Food and Fry
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Food and Fry**
Use fine complete food for fry, stage-appropriate Artemia and varied supplements with clean water; do not equate product marketing or higher protein numbers with proven superior growth.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/food/
Sources: https://www.ifga.org/basiccare

threads.name: Guppypedia — Disease Prevention
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Disease Prevention**
Quarantine new fish, test water, and identify the problem before treatments. Inbreeding has been associated with higher Gyrodactylus infection burden in controlled guppy research.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/health/
Sources: https://www.merckvetmanual.com/exotic-and-laboratory-animals/aquarium-fish/management-of-aquarium-fish | https://doi.org/10.1016/j.exppara.2016.04.018

threads.name: Guppypedia — Endler and Hybrid Labels
threads.starterContent:
Aquapedia • Guppypedia • source-reviewed 2026-10-20
**Guppypedia — Endler and Hybrid Labels**
Poecilia wingei is a separate species and can hybridize with common guppies. A dealer label alone cannot establish a pure wild-origin line.
Aquapedia: https://aquapedia.app/guppypedia/endlers/
Sources: https://www.ikgh.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/IHS-Version-2023.pdf
